name: answerrail-mcp
description: 6-category AI readiness, Schema.org JSON-LD, robots.txt AI bot rules, /llms.txt, Google Lighthouse 13.5 ARD 1.0 (ai-catalog.json), and 25,000-token price recall audit MCP server.
author: The Quite Good Project

tools.name: audit_local_codebase
tools.description: Performs a strictly read-only structural scan of a local repository workspace (package.json, robots.txt, public/llms.txt, and public/.well-known/ai-catalog.json) without modifying files on disk.

tools.name: audit_ai_readiness
tools.description: Executes a read-only live HTTP diagnostic against a remote URL or domain for AI crawler access, 25,000-token HTML RAG truncation, /llms.txt presence, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, and Google Lighthouse 13.5 Agentic Browsing (/.well-known/ai-catalog.json ARD 1.0).

tools.name: generate_ai_manifests
tools.description: Synthesizes a read-only 6-line /llms.txt Markdown index preview and a Google Lighthouse 13.5 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (ARD 1.0) JSON manifest preview from a live remote domain, plus 2-tier remediation links ( 7-File Fix Pack or /mo Edge Proxy).

tools.name: extract_byte0_markdown
tools.description: Fetches a live web page and strips React/Next.js hydration scripts and DOM bloat, returning clean Byte-0 GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) with front-loaded Schema.org tables.

tools.name: query_truncation_benchmark
tools.description: Queries empirical benchmark data from the 2026 50-Site SaaS & E-Commerce AI Truncation Study.
